name: mnb/mnb-phpexcel
description: Framework-neutral modular PHP spreadsheet toolkit for XLSX, XLS, CSV, JSON, XML, ODS, SQL, distributed jobs, HTTP workflows, and low-memory streaming.

suggest.ext-zip: Recommended for maximum XLSX/ODS package performance; a pure-PHP fallback is included.
suggest.ext-xmlreader: Recommended for true low-memory XML/XLSX/ODS streaming; a secure pure-PHP fallback is included.
suggest.ext-mbstring: Recommended for better UTF-8/legacy encoding handling.
suggest.mnb/mnb-phpexcel-core: Install the lightweight shared reader/session API when using split format packages.
suggest.mnb/mnb-phpexcel-xlsx: Install only native XLSX support in modular deployments.
suggest.mnb/mnb-phpexcel-xml: Install only XML support in modular deployments.
suggest.phpoffice/phpspreadsheet: Installed automatically by the XLS/all split packages for BIFF8 XLS and specialist formula compatibility.
